scope: Motor A retrospective method only; no Prediction integration, Motor B, Rating v2, or 2025 holdout evaluation

residual.national_win_rate_source: brd_l3.zenkoku_ritsu_1, carried as core.race_entry.national_win_rate with VALID status and raw lineage

ordered_conditions: canonical individual result present and finish_state is not NO_INDIVIDUAL_RESULT
core.race_entry.national_win_rate_status = VALID and national_win_rate is non-NULL
eligibility.ineligible_entry_visit: still participates in meeting/motor continuity tracking, but adds no residual

meeting_identity.algorithm: scripts/motor_a_v1.py build_meeting_days, ported from development motor_a_meeting_supported.py build
meeting_identity.start: L1 day marker 1, or blank L1 marker with same-day B1/K1 day marker 1 agreement
meeting_identity.validation: same-day B1/K1 agreement, L1 nonblank day agreement except final 9, stable L1 title, supported day-number transitions
meeting_identity.repeated_blank_start: same title and consecutive blank L1 / B1 day-1 signals stay in one meeting, as in development
meeting_identity.canonical_mapping: core.race venue_code x race_date must match L1 venue-day
meeting_identity.unknown_no_final_9: start known: Current is scored through D-1; this meeting is never appended to completed Base history
meeting_identity.unknown_no_start_1: start unknown: Base and Current are NOT_EVALUABLE on its rows
meeting_identity.other_unknown_reasons: Current is unknown unless the sole reason is NO_FINAL_9; never append to completed Base history
meeting_identity.uncertain_intervening_meeting: clear earlier completed Base history when its start is unknown, or when the next meeting follows a noncertified prior meeting

motor_a_base3.definition: arithmetic mean of the per-meeting mean residuals for the most recent at most three completed, certified, eligible-used meetings of the same motor generation before the current meeting
motor_a_base3.meeting_weight: EQUAL; do not pool all races across meetings
motor_a_base3.selection: only meetings with one or more eligible uses; require source final-day 9 before D
motor_a_base3.base_n_uses: sum of eligible uses across the selected meetings
motor_a_base3.base_residual_sum: sum of all eligible residuals in the selected meetings; companion quantity, not an additional v1 score

motor_a_current.definition: mean residual of eligible uses of the same motor generation in the current source-identified meeting with race_date < D

features.type: two separate continuous residual scores, not probabilities and not an additive combined score
features.same_player: include current player's eligible prior uses in the same meeting; no exclusion
features.fallback_or_imputation: NONE; do not use previous generation, same motor number, or venue average
features.history_quantity: Current residual sum is current mean x current_n_uses; Base residual sum is retained separately because its equal-meeting-weight mean x base_n_uses is not a pooled-use sum

time_boundary.common_state: every D race uses the same D-1 residual state
time_boundary.result_update: apply all D eligible results only after all D entries are scored; usable from D+1
time_boundary.base_finalization: a certified meeting becomes completed only after its final-day D results are committed; first available for Base after D

development_evidence.analysis: 2017-2022 linear diagnostic fit, separately applied to 2023 and 2024; continuous next-residual MSE, not calibrated probability quality

race_recent5_comparator.definition: mean of the most recent at most five eligible uses of the same motor generation before D
race_recent5_comparator.interpretation: close comparator; 2024 race5 is marginally lower MSE on this cohort, so no universal superiority claim for the two-layer scores

known_limitations: No 2025 independent holdout result or Prediction integration is asserted.
Development diagnostics estimate next residual, not first/second-place probabilities or calibration.
Current includes same-player and player-motor interaction; it is not identified as a pure motor effect.
Start-unknown meetings cannot yield meeting scores, and uncertain intervening identity resets Base continuity.
Historical per-entry L3 publication timestamps were not recorded; this method uses the adopted day-level operating boundary, without claiming timestamp-level proof.
The hashed development files are local ignored artifacts, not included in this checkpoint; the freeze JSON preserves selected aggregate results and provenance.
